description.text:
Exclusive Pelago Disney Cruise Deal!

Earn 5,000 bonus KrisFlyer miles AND earn 3 miles for every dollar spent! 🚢✨ Hurry, this limited-time offer won’t last!


Cruise Highlights

  • Enchanting Voyages: Choose 3-, 4-, or 5-night cruises from Singapore—a magical journey where the ship becomes your ultimate destination! No ports, no stops—just endless fun and enchantment before returning to where the adventure began!
  • World-Class Entertainment: Enjoy dazzling live shows, kids’ clubs, and meet beloved Disney Characters.
  • Themed Dining: Delight in creative and signature Disney dining experiences.


Onboard Experiences

  • Luxurious Accommodations: Stay in thoughtfully designed Disney-inspired staterooms.
  • Water Fun: Splash into fun-filled water play areas and pools.
  • Pampering & Shopping: Indulge in spa treatments or explore exclusive shopping onboard.


A Ship Like No Other

  • Themed Areas: Immerse yourself in 7 magical zones, including Marvel Landing and Toy Story Place.
  • Southeast Asia Exclusives: Enjoy special features tailored just for this region.


Discover the enchanting stories of Disney, Marvel, and Pixar brought to life, making your voyage unforgettable! 


Need more info? Visit our comprehensive Disney Adventure guide to explore Pro Tips, How to Book, and Must-Do Activities!

childPolicy.heading: Child Policy
childPolicy.text:
• A guest's age is determined by their first sailing date.
  • Children under 13 qualify for the child rate; those 13 and older are charged the adult rate.
  • For most itineraries, the minimum age to sail is 6 months at time of embarkation.
  • Child prices listed here apply to children aged 1 to 12 years old. For children aged 6 to 11 months, please contact our customer service team.
  • Infants aged 6 months and older can travel on Disney Cruises, with special accommodations and baby amenities available onboard.
  • Minors under 18 traveling without a parent or legal guardian must be accompanied by an adult (21+ years) in the same stateroom.
  • A minor authorization form is required for each child travelling without a parent or legal guardian. The form, completed by the parent or guardian, must be presented at check-in and can be downloaded here.

goodToKnow.heading: Good To Know
goodToKnow.text:
• All other purchases onboard Disney Cruise—including spa services, premium dining and onboard shopping—are priced in US dollars. These charges will be billed to your onboard folio, which is payable in cash or with a major credit card.
  • Depending on your nationality, you may need an entry visa to enter Singapore. Each guest needs to ensure they have the necessary visas before the cruise.
  • Please ensure your passport has at least six months of validity until the end of your cruise.
  • To ensure a smooth journey, please make sure you have the required documentation to avoid any issues with boarding. For more details, you can check the full list of required travel documents here.
  • By booking this cruise, all guests confirm their understanding and agreement to the Terms & Conditions and Cruise Contract.

bookingConfirmation.heading: Booking Confirmation
bookingConfirmation.text:
• Your booking request will be processed within 72 hours.
  • The final booking price is subject to change, depending on the time of your booking.
  • If you need assistance with your booking, feel free to submit a request here. We're happy to help!
  • In case your booking cannot be confirmed or is cancelled, Kris+ will retrieve the required KrisPay miles from your KrisPay wallet. In the event of insufficient KrisPay miles, Kris+ may deduct the necessary amount of KrisFlyer miles in your KrisFlyer account.

amendmentPolicy.heading: Amendment Policy
amendmentPolicy.text:
• Staterooms can be changed or upgraded, subject to availability, certain requirements and restrictions.
  • Any requests for any booking change may incur a 5% change fee.
  • As your cruise price is based on specific travel details, any changes you make may affect the price.
  • Adjustments to your stateroom category, type, or location are possible (subject to availability).
  • For bookings with multiple staterooms, each must be updated individually.

refundpolicy.heading: Refund Policy
refundpolicy.text:
Pelago’s Refund and Cancellation Policy for Disney Adventure


For all bookings on Pelago & Kris+, not using KF miles redemption:

Standard Staterooms (Excluding Suites and Concierge Staterooms):

  • 91 days or more before the sail date: 100% of the price paid is refundable* 
  • 90 to 46 days before the sail date: 80% of the price paid is refundable*
  • 45 to 31 days before the sail date: 50% of the price paid is refundable*
  • 30 to 16 days before the sail date: 25% of the price paid is refundable*
  • 15 days or less before the sail date: 0% of the price paid is refundable*

Suites and Concierge Staterooms:

  • 46 days or more before the sail date: no refund of 10% upfront payment. 90% of the price paid is refundable if booking is already paid in full*
  • 45 to 31 days before the sail date: 50% of the price paid is refundable*
  • 30 to 16 days before the sail date: 25% of the price paid is refundable*
  • 15 days or less before the sail date: 0% of the price paid is refundable*

*Any cancellation will incur an additional 5% handling fee on the amount paid to Pelago in accordance with the refund terms above. 


Important Notes:

  • Amendments are allowed, subject to any fare differences and may incur a 5% change fee.
  • KrisFlyer miles redemption bookings are non-refundable.

afterbooking.heading: After Booking & Before Sail Departure
afterbooking.text:
• Guests are advised to provide their passport number at least 75 days prior to the start of their holiday in the Guest Information Form in My Online Check-in.
  • Guests must present a copy of the Online Check-In Port Arrival Form at check-in.
  • You can save time during the boarding process by completing this document ahead of time through My Online Check-in.

pelagoExclusiveOffer.heading: Pelago Exclusive Offer
pelagoExclusiveOffer.text:
For a limited time only, book a Disney Cruise on Pelago and enjoy a bonus 5,000 KrisFlyer miles, on top of earning 3 miles per dollar spent! 🚢


  • 🌟 Imagine this: Book a SGD3,500 Stateroom and rack up 15,500 KrisFlyer miles (3 miles x SGD3,500 + 5,000 bonus miles)!
  • And that’s not all—stack the rewards with your credit card to earn even more miles, cashback, or perks!


Don’t miss out—start booking your dream adventure today!


Need more info? Visit our comprehensive Disney Adventure guide to explore Pro Tips, How to Book, and Must-Do Activities!

rotationalDiningInformation.heading: Rotational Dining Information
rotationalDiningInformation.text:
What is Rotational Dining?

Rotational dining ensures you experience all three themed dining venues during your cruise. Each evening, you, your tablemates, and your servers will rotate to a new restaurant. Your serving team stays with you throughout the cruise, learning your preferences to provide personalized service.


How It Works:

Your dining schedule and table number are available in the Disney Cruise Line Navigator App upon boarding. Dinner has two seatings:

  • Early Seating: ~5:45 PM
  • Late Seating: ~8:15 PM

(Times may vary by 15 minutes)

Regardless of your seating, you'll have time to enjoy dinner and attend either the early or late live stage shows.


Dining Highlights:

  • Enjoy three uniquely themed dining experiences with a preset schedule included in your booking.
  • Children's menus are available at all dining venues.
  • Additional adult-exclusive dining options (18+ only) are available for an extra charge. These can be booked in advance and may replace a rotational dining night.


Adult-Only Dining:

  • For a more exclusive experience, adults 18+ can dine at specialty restaurants, with an additional charge.
  • These can be booked for brunch (which won’t impact your rotational dinners) or dinner (which may replace one rotational dining venue).
  • For longer cruises, you can time these visits to avoid missing out on rotational options.
  • On shorter sailings (3 nights or less), rotational venues are also open for breakfast and lunch, and you can check the Navigator App for details.


Rotational dining combines magical themes, personalized service, and flexibility for an unforgettable culinary journey!

lookingForASpecificRoomType.heading: Looking for a specific room type?
lookingForASpecificRoomType.text: If you’re looking for a specific room type that isn’t listed and need help with your booking, we’re here for you! Just submit a request at pel.sg/help.

sections.question: What's included in the cruise fare?
sections.answer: The price includes your stateroom, meals (breakfast, lunch, and dinner), soft drinks, snacks, Disney Character Meet & Greets, and entertainment. Optional services like spa treatments, phone calls, alcoholic drinks, and adults-only dining are available for an additional charge.

sections.question: Are Wi-Fi and phone services available on the ship?
sections.answer: Wi-Fi is available onboard for an additional fee. Phone services are also available for use while cruising, though international roaming charges may apply.

sections.question: Are there activities for different age groups on Disney Cruise ships?
sections.answer: Yes! Disney Cruise ships offer a variety of activities for all ages. Infants can enjoy group playtime at the Nursery (for an additional fee), while kids have pools, youth clubs, and character experiences. Tweens (11-14) can hang out at Edge with fun activities, and teens (14-17) can enjoy the Vibe lounge. Adults can relax with exclusive venues like fitness centers, spas, and adults-only dining.

sections.question: What documents do I need for my cruise?
sections.answer: A valid passport or other government-approved ID is required for boarding. Specific documentation may vary based on your nationality and cruise itinerary. Ensure your passport is valid for at least six months beyond your cruise end date.

sections.question: Are meals included in the Disney Adventure experience?
sections.answer: Meals are typically included during the Disney Adventure excursions, but it's advisable to check the specific details for each adventure as offerings may vary.

sections.question: Can I choose my preferred dinner seating?
sections.answer: Yes, Disney Cruise offers two dining seatings. You can choose between the first or second seating, and each night, you'll rotate through different themed dining venues with the same servers.

sections.question: Can dietary requests or food allergies be accommodated?
sections.answer: Disney Cruise Line offers options like gluten-free, vegetarian, no-sugar-added, and dairy-free meals. For dietary needs, visit My Reservations to submit a Special Requests (e.g., halal, kosher) or Special Services (e.g., severe allergies) form. Requests must be submitted at least 3 days prior to sailing, except kosher or halal meals, which require 5 weeks' notice.

sections.question: Is there an age requirement for children traveling?
sections.answer: Disney Cruise Line is family-friendly and welcomes children of all ages. Children under 18 traveling without a parent or guardian must be accompanied by an adult aged 21 or older and require a minor authorization form. Some activities may have age restrictions.

sections.question: Can I change or upgrade my stateroom after booking?
sections.answer: Yes, you can change or upgrade your stateroom, subject to availability and price changes. Contact Pelago customer service for assistance. If you have multiple staterooms, each one must be updated separately.

sections.question: Are Guests allowed to bring alcoholic beverages on board the ship?
sections.answer:
Guests aged 21 and above may bring a maximum of:
• 2 bottles of unopened wine or champagne (750ml or less each), or
• 6 beers (12oz or less each)

These beverages must be packed in carry-on luggage, not checked bags.
A corking fee of USD 29 will apply for wine or champagne consumed in dining rooms.

Important Notes
• Alcohol in checked luggage will be confiscated without compensation.
• Only unopened bottles are allowed. Partially used or broken seals are prohibited.
• Excess alcohol (over 2 bottles of wine/champagne or 6 beers) must be discarded, with no compensation.
•Alcohol consumption is not permitted in public areas or lounges.
•The alcohol policy may change without notice.

sections.question: Can I request connecting or wheelchair-accessible rooms?
sections.answer: We’re unable to accommodate requests for connecting or wheelchair-accessible rooms, as all rooms are assigned based on availability at the time of booking.
